newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices firm at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices firm at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were firm at the weekly auction in Mombasa boosted by strong demand, auction officials said.
Brighter PF1s appreciated by 4-12 U.S cents while coloury mediums edged up by 3-9 cents. Lower mediums gained up to eight cents while Brighter PDUSTs were firm to 12 cents dearer.
Brighter, cleaner Fannings were dearer while BMFs shed 2-8 cents.
Pakistan was very active with good support from Egypt. Britain was less active, while Somalia showed limited interest.
